states: Embedded production build of this change on the full mock estate, signed in through the real login
Proxmox: clicking a node row narrows the guests from 58 rows to that node's 3, marks the row, titles the table "Guests on London Edge Standalone" and moves focus to that heading; unchanged from main

Docker: clicking a host row sets ?host=auth-service-01, keeps all 7 hosts listed with that row marked, adds the Host chip, narrows the containers from 82 rows to 5 and titles them "Containers on auth-service-01" with Show all hosts
vSphere: clicking a host row sets the workload host scope, keeps all 7 hosts listed with that row marked, narrows the VMs from 25 rows to esxi-02's group and titles them "VMs on esxi-02.lab.local 1"
On every platform the row chevron opens the host drawer without changing the scope, Show all clears the scope and refocuses the heading, and phones keep the chevron visible
At 390px the Docker and vSphere host names stay readable (App Platfor..., esxi-01.lab.l...) after the chevron is added
Docker Swarm tab: its host table has no containers under it, so a row click still opens the host drawer and no scope buttons render
No console or page errors at either width
interactions: Row click on a host scopes the workload table; a second click on the same host clears it
Chevron click opens and closes the host drawer
Show all hosts / Show all nodes clears the scope
scope: Full authenticated application on a mock estate; mock data, not live provider connections.
